evidence: Plaut. Most. 5.1.66, as cited by Lewis & Short: ēlixus esse quam assus soleō suāvior
terms.comment: Plautus contrasts it with assus, roast. ēlixāre, boil, is late (Apicius; M-O s.v. stew).

phrases.latin: Ōvum ēlixum mihi placet, nōn frīctum.
phrases.english: I like a boiled egg, not a fried one.

sources: Lewis & Short: elixus · Lewis & Short: elixo
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. boil.
